description: Fresher target-role catalogue for PrepVista. Each role maps to the branches that can apply, the company types that hire for it, its key competencies (canonical set), the question categories it emphasises, and a comprehensive set of 20+ relevant skills (technical, tools, concepts, soft). Used by the orchestrator to tailor interviews and by the resume matcher to score skill coverage.

roles.label: Software Engineer / SDE
roles.description: Builds and maintains software; the core fresher tech role.

roles.label: Backend Developer
roles.description: Builds server-side logic, APIs, and data layers.

roles.label: Frontend Developer
roles.description: Builds user interfaces and client-side experiences.

roles.label: Full-Stack Developer
roles.description: Works across frontend, backend, and databases.

roles.label: QA / Test Engineer
roles.description: Designs tests and ensures software quality.

roles.label: Systems Engineer
roles.description: Configures and supports systems and infrastructure.

roles.label: Data Scientist
roles.description: Builds models and extracts insight from data.

roles.label: MLOps Engineer
roles.description: Operationalises and monitors ML in production.

roles.label: Cybersecurity Analyst
roles.description: Monitors and defends systems against threats.

roles.label: SOC Analyst
roles.description: Operates a security operations centre, triaging alerts.

roles.label: Penetration Tester
roles.description: Tests systems by ethically attacking them.

roles.label: Business Analyst
roles.description: Bridges business needs and technical solutions.

roles.label: Product Analyst
roles.description: Uses data to inform product decisions.

roles.label: Site Engineer
roles.description: Executes and supervises construction on site.

roles.label: Implementation Engineer
roles.description: Deploys and configures solutions for clients.
